handoff_metadata.completion_trigger: All foundational usecase discovery questions satisfied by client

usecase_summary.client_name: PVR INOX | Contract Intelligence & Risk Visibility Platform
usecase_summary.engagement_title: PVR INOX | Contract Intelligence & Risk Visibility Platform — AI Planning & Automation Platform
usecase_summary.problem_statement: PVR INOX signs contracts across lease, vendor, service, facilities, technology and marketing categories. Manual review takes 4-5 business days per contract and deviations from approved standards are not caught consistently. Findings live in disconnected spreadsheets with zero traceability to source clauses.
usecase_summary.non_ai_interventions: 600 representative contracts across 6 categories (100 per category), 200 named users, 50 concurrent users, 2,000 requests/day, single instance HA/DR.
usecase_summary.sizing_scale: Internal policy only, standard enterprise security, platform-managed encryption, corporate Entra ID SSO, India data residency.
usecase_summary.governance_and_compliance: ≥95% classification accuracy, ≥95% clause extraction rate, 100% traceability between findings and PDF page coordinates, and Agree / Agree with Mgmt Approval / Not Agree classification.

handoff_instructions_for_next_agent.mandate: Synthesize a production-ready Business Requirements Document (BRD) and comprehensive Project Plan based strictly on the mapped requirements above.

2. 7-discipline resource loading table calculating hours and total labour cost at blended rate
3. 4-Phase Delivery Roadmap factoring the regional statutory calendar & working days
4. Cloud Bill of Materials (BoM) with monthly cost estimation
